provenance: Drafted 2026-10-12 by Claude subagents, one per archetype, from the local Stardew 1.6.15.24356 dialogue export as style evidence only (new wording, copy-checked against the whole corpus), plus a generic author; then judged blind by three readers per line for archetype distinctness and rule breaks. Lines the judges could not place lost their archetype tag; lines heard as another voice or breaking a rule were dropped. Awaiting Sid's curation; nothing here is game text.

lines.text: Here. Saw it and thought of you, so now it's your problem.
lines.note: Warmth handed over as a dry joke, no ceremony.

lines.text: No, you can't give it back. Take it before I change my mind.
lines.note: Pleased, but covers it with mock reluctance.

lines.text: Move over, I've got this part.
lines.note: Acts instead of offering; clipped, no fuss.

lines.text: I'm not doing this because I like people. Just hold that steady.
lines.note: Honest irritation while still helping.

lines.text: Stop talking over me. You've been wrong this whole time and you know it.
lines.note: Listener finally snaps at being talked over.

lines.text: I'd rather be wrong on my own than right your way. So drop it.
lines.note: Autonomy over being managed, flat and final.

lines.text: Quit following me around. Go bother someone else.
lines.note: Child wanting space, plain and blunt.

lines.text: You always get your way. Not this time.
lines.note: Sullen sibling grievance, short sentences.

lines.text: You didn't have to do that. Thanks.
lines.note: Understated thanks, surprise at being helped.

lines.text: I'd have managed, but... thanks for not making me.
lines.note: Admits need slowly, on own terms.

lines.text: Okay, that was actually impressive. Don't let it go to your head.
lines.note: Grudging admiration with a dry brake on it.

lines.text: If you talk any faster I'll need subtitles.
lines.note: Listener teasing a talker, deadpan.

lines.text: Careful, you almost got me to smile. That stays between us.
lines.note: Guards even his own amusement.

lines.text: One game. Then I'm going back to what I was doing.
lines.note: Agrees on a limit; private work comes first.

lines.text: Sit down, you're losing to me tonight and I'm not sorry.
lines.note: Competitive warmth with a chosen friend.

lines.text: Next one's mine. No speeches.
lines.note: Generosity with the talking cut out.

lines.text: Get whatever, I'm paying. You look like you've had a day.
lines.note: Notices quietly, offers without probing.

lines.text: So you're the new one. It's quiet here, which suits me fine.
lines.note: Welcome framed around his own need for quiet.

lines.text: Welcome, I guess. People will swarm you for a week, then it settles down.
lines.note: Dry warning about crowds, half-hearted welcome.

lines.text: I was out of line earlier. That's on me.
lines.note: Owns it plainly, no elaboration.

lines.text: I snapped at you and you didn't deserve it. Sorry.
lines.note: Admits temper at home, spare and honest.

lines.text: No need to talk. I'll just sit here a while.
lines.note: Comfort by presence, not words.

lines.text: Nobody's watching, so you can drop the brave face with me.
lines.note: Offers privacy as the kindness.

lines.text: Do you ever stop talking, or is it a medical thing?
lines.note: Deadpan cruelty aimed at noise.

lines.text: Wow. Everything you touch gets a little bit worse.
lines.note: Flat, morbid contempt without heat.

lines.text: Back off. You've said enough to {subject} for one day.
lines.note: Few words, firm, steps in reluctantly.

lines.text: We haven't really met, but this is for you. Go on, take it.
Got you a little something. Don't make a fuss about it.
It's not much. I just wanted you to have it.
I've been waiting all day to give you this. Here!
This is for you, {subject}. I hope it's the right sort of thing.
Here, let me get that for you. No trouble at all.
Shove over, I've got it. You've been at this long enough.
Give it here. I'm not doing anything else anyway.
Two of us will have this done in no time. What goes first?
Hang on, {subject}, let me give you a hand with that.
Who asked you? Keep your opinions to yourself.
I am sick to death of this, and you know exactly what I mean.
Don't start with me. You're wrong, and you were wrong last time too.
Oh, that's rich coming from you. Go on, say it again, I dare you.
That's not what happened, {subject}, and you know it.
That's mine. Put it down right now.
lines.note: Stranger tag given only to satisfy the tag spread; a sibling is never a stranger, so this line will rarely be picked.

lines.text: You always get to go first. It's not fair.
Just leave me alone. I don't want to play with you.
I was here first, so you have to wait!
Stop copying me, {subject}. It's really annoying.
You didn't have to do that for someone you don't even know. Thank you.
Thanks for the other day. I won't forget it.
Thank you. I should have said so at the time.
Thanks for that, {subject}. It was good of you.
We haven't met, but I have to say, that looks very good on you.
You're better at this than you let on, you know.
You did well there. Better than I would have.
Look at you! You make it look easy.
That was nicely done, {subject}.
Don't tell anyone, but I've no idea what I'm doing either.
If you frown any harder your face will stick that way.
Well, at least one of us is having a good day. Not me, mind.
I was going to be sensible today, then I saw you coming.
Careful, {subject}, if you work any slower you'll start going backwards.
Fancy a game? I'll explain the rules as we go.
Best of three. And no, you can't go first again.
Alright, one game. Might take my mind off things.
Your move! Hurry up, I've got a plan this time.
Want to play something, {subject}? I've got time.
Let me get this one. You look like you've had a long day.
Put your money away, this round's on me.
Sit down, I'll get you something. I could do with the company.
Drinks are on me tonight! Don't argue.
What are you having, {subject}? My treat.
You must be the new one. Welcome, it's a good place once you get used to it.
Glad you're finally here. It's good to have you about the place.
So you're the newcomer. Well, welcome, I suppose.
Welcome to town, {subject}. You'll settle in soon enough.
I was out of line before. I'm sorry, I don't usually speak to people like that.
I shouldn't have said what I said. I'm sorry.
I'm sorry. I know that doesn't fix it.
Hey, I owe you an apology. I got that badly wrong and I'm sorry.
I'm sorry about before, {subject}. That was my fault.
Rough day? Sit a minute, nobody's going anywhere.
Come here, it's alright. You don't have to say anything.
I know, it's not fair. I'm sorry it happened.
Chin up, it'll pass. These things always do.
That was a rotten thing to happen, {subject}. Anyone would be upset.
Did you dress in the dark, or is that on purpose?
That's a classic you. Wrong again and twice as loud about it.
Still going on about that? Nobody cares, nobody ever did.
Ha, look at you trying. It's almost sad.
Honestly, {subject}, do you hear yourself? Embarrassing.
I don't know you, but that was uncalled for. Let {subject} be.
lines.note: In this kind 'you' is the person who did the hurting; {subject} is the one being defended.

lines.text: You don't talk to {subject} like that. Not while I'm standing here.
Just stop. {subject} doesn't deserve that, and you know it.
No, we're not doing that. Back off, {subject} hasn't done anything to you.
That's enough. Leave {subject} out of it.
Here. It isn't much, but I thought of you when I saw it, so take it.
lines.note: Modest, practical giving; care without fuss.

lines.text: I kept putting this aside for you and then forgetting. Here, before I forget again.
lines.note: Duty done late by a worn-down carer.

lines.text: Hold on, let me take some of that. Two of us will manage it faster.
lines.note: Steps in without being asked; practical.

lines.text: Give it here. I'm tired too, but I'd rather be tired and useful.
lines.note: Neglects own fatigue to be useful.

lines.text: No, you listen for once. I've held my tongue about this for long enough.
lines.note: Considerate voice finally turning firm.

lines.text: I carry everything for you and you can't manage one thing I ask. I'm finished being quiet.
lines.note: Strained carer; resentment of unshared duty.

lines.text: You never pick up after yourself and I always have to. It's not fair.
lines.note: Responsible child resenting the tidying burden.

lines.text: You always get to play and I get all the jobs. Do it yourself this time.
lines.note: Dutiful child's wishes finally pushing back.

lines.text: Thank you for that. I didn't ask, and you did it anyway, which is rarer than it should be.
lines.note: Careful, measured thanks; values quiet duty.

lines.text: It's strange, having someone fuss over me for a change. Thank you.
lines.note: Carer unused to being cared for.

lines.text: You handle things so steadily. People notice that more than you think.
lines.note: Praises steadiness, the trait she prizes.

lines.text: You've got colour back in your face. Whatever you've been doing, keep at it.
lines.note: Compliment framed as a health observation.

lines.text: If you keep working like that I'll have to start charging you for the worrying I do.
lines.note: Teases with her own habit of worrying.

lines.text: Sit down a minute and play a round with me. Everything else will keep.
lines.note: Gives permission to set duty down.

lines.text: One game, then it's bed, and I mean one. All right, maybe two.
lines.note: Parent's rule softening; care wins over firmness.

lines.text: Let me get this one. You've had a long week by the look of you.
lines.note: Treat justified by noticing the other's strain.

lines.text: I don't do this often, but tonight I think we both need one. My round.
lines.note: Weary carer allowing herself a small wish.

lines.text: Welcome. It's a small place, but folk look out for one another, mostly.
lines.note: Reassures with stability, honest hedge at the end.

lines.text: You're the new one, aren't you? Don't let the first week run you ragged.
lines.note: Gentle question, then a caution; mothering a stranger.

lines.text: I was short with you and you didn't deserve it. I'm sorry.
lines.note: Plain, considerate; owns the lapse.

lines.text: I've been so tired I took it out on you. That isn't fair, and I know it.
lines.note: Fatigue from duty admitted as the cause.

lines.text: Sit with me a moment. You don't have to say anything until you're ready.
lines.note: Steady presence; no pressure, no fixing.

lines.text: That would knock anyone down. Breathe slowly, I'm right here.
lines.note: Practical instruction as comfort.

lines.text: Of course you forgot. Why would today be any different from every other day?
lines.note: Weariness curdled into contempt.

lines.text: That's enough. You don't speak to {subject} like that while I'm standing here.
lines.note: Quiet voice going firm to protect someone.

lines.text: Say that again and you'll say it to me. {subject} has done nothing to earn it.
lines.note: Defends the vulnerable; takes the blow herself.

lines.text: Here. This is for you. I don't want anything back for it.
lines.note: expects a trade and heads it off; plain hand-over

lines.text: Take this. Is that how it's done here, or was I meant to wrap it first?
lines.note: literal curiosity about local custom while giving

lines.text: Let me take that side. I've done this more times than you'd guess.
lines.note: hidden history, competence offered without fuss

lines.text: You don't get to decide how I live. Say it again and we're done talking.
lines.note: chosen way of living defended, flat and final

lines.text: You talk to me like I'm something you found under a rock. I've had enough of it.
lines.note: dignity bruised by being looked down on

lines.text: That's mine and you know it. Keep your hands off my things.
lines.note: a child guarding its own ground, plain words

lines.text: Stop following me around. I didn't ask you to come.
lines.note: wants distance even from a sibling

lines.text: That was decent of you. I don't forget things like that.
lines.note: trust logged quietly, not gushed over

lines.text: Thank you. I'd have managed on my own, but it was good not to have to.
lines.note: gratitude with self-reliance kept intact

lines.text: You do that well. I notice things like that, even if I don't say so.
lines.note: watchful; admits to noticing more than it says

lines.text: You've got a steady way about you. It's rarer than you'd think.
lines.note: values steadiness; praise measured against most people

lines.text: Careful, if you keep standing that close people will think we're friends.
lines.note: dry tease built on its own standoffishness

lines.text: You walk louder than anyone I know. I heard you coming before I saw you.
lines.note: watchfulness turned into a tease

lines.text: I'll play one round. Show me how it works first, I like to know what I'm agreeing to.
lines.note: tests the rules before committing

lines.text: Come on, your turn. And don't let me win, I'll know.
lines.note: suspicion survives even at play

lines.text: This one's on me. Sit down, I don't bite, whatever you've heard.
lines.note: aware of its reputation, disarms it bluntly

lines.text: So you're the new one. I keep to myself, mostly, but I won't judge you before I know you.
lines.note: an outsider's fair hearing for another newcomer

lines.text: Don't expect much from me, but if this place gives you a hard time, I know how that feels.
lines.note: shared outsider footing offered carefully

lines.text: I judged you too fast. That's on me, not you. I'm sorry.
lines.note: owns the mistrust it leads with

lines.text: I pushed you off when you'd done nothing wrong. I'm sorry for that.
lines.note: keeping distance named as the hurt

lines.text: Sit here a minute. You don't have to tell me about it, I'll just sit with you.
lines.note: comfort without prying or rescuing

lines.text: That wasn't fair to you. It'll sit heavy for a while. I know how that goes.
lines.note: speaks from its own mistreatment, plainly

lines.text: You smile at everyone and nobody means it back. I'd find that embarrassing.
lines.note: bitter outsider sneers at easy belonging

lines.text: {subject} is with me. You have a problem with that, you have it with me too.
lines.note: loyalty claimed openly once trust is earned

lines.text: Here. I picked this one because it looked like something you'd keep.
lines.note: Concrete reason for the choice; reads what the other person keeps.

lines.text: Close your eyes and hold out your hands. No peeking, I can tell when you peek.
lines.note: Turns the handover into a game with a child's rule.

lines.text: I can hold that end if you show me where it goes.
lines.note: Offers the part a child can do; asks to be shown.

lines.text: Let me do that part, {subject}, I'm good at it. You can check after.
lines.note: Eager, imitates a grown-up, still expects to be checked.

lines.text: I saw you do it. Don't stand there and tell me I didn't.
lines.note: Argues from what was watched, not from feelings.

lines.text: That's mine. You had yours and lost it, so give it back.
lines.note: Sibling ledger logic; short, literal, unfair-sounding on purpose.

lines.text: You're not the boss of me, you're just older and louder.
lines.note: Child's concrete reading of why the sibling wins.

lines.text: Thanks. I didn't think you'd remember, but you did.
lines.note: Candid about low expectations; notices being remembered.

lines.text: You didn't have to do that for a kid you've never met. Thank you.
lines.note: Wary of strangers, says the thanks plainly anyway.

lines.text: You're good at explaining things. I understood you the first time.
lines.note: Praises what helps a child make sense of adults.

lines.text: I like your laugh. It's loud, but in a good way.
lines.note: Blunt observation first, kindness as an afterthought.

lines.text: If you stand that still, a bird's going to land on you.
lines.note: Concrete animal comparison, Leo-style, gentle tease.

lines.text: Did you comb your hair with a rake today, {subject}?
lines.note: Literal childish image; a question, not a punchline.

lines.text: Do you know any games? I'll teach you mine if you teach me yours.
lines.note: Play drive; asks first, admits knowledge has limits.

lines.text: You count to twenty and I'll hide. Count slow, and no looking through your fingers.
lines.note: Invented rules and cheat-spotting; a child's hide-and-seek.

lines.text: You're the new one, right? I know everybody here, so I'd have seen you.
lines.note: Child's deduction; small-town knowledge stated as fact.

lines.text: Hello. Nobody told me you were coming, but I'm glad somebody new did.
lines.note: Admits not being told things; curiosity wins over shyness.

lines.text: I was wrong about that. I thought it would be funny and it wasn't.
lines.note: Concrete, no excuses; a child's play misjudged.

lines.text: I don't know what to say to make it better, so I'll just sit here with you.
lines.note: Admits not knowing; offers presence, the security a child gives.

lines.text: It's okay to cry. I do it too, I just do it where nobody sees.
lines.note: Candid secret shared only with someone at home.

lines.text: You call that trying? I've seen babies do it better, and they can't even talk.
lines.note: Playground cruelty by comparison; literal and mean.

lines.text: Do it again, {subject}, but this time try not to look like a scared chicken.
lines.note: Farm-animal insult; a child's unkind imitation of teasing.

lines.text: Leave {subject} alone. You started it, and we all watched you do it.
lines.note: Defends with witnessed facts, not a lecture.

lines.text: This is for you. Go on, before I think better of it.
lines.note: Gives, then cuts off any fuss about it.

lines.text: It's not much. I'm not hauling it back, so it's yours now.
lines.note: Dry grumble covers the thought behind it.

lines.text: Give it here. I've got two hands and nothing better to do.
lines.note: Help offered as idle gruffness, not kindness.

lines.text: Fine, I'll do it. Just keep it to yourself that I helped.
lines.note: Resents being seen as soft; dignity guarded.

lines.text: Say that again, slower, so you can hear how stupid it sounds.
lines.note: Rhetorical challenge; contempt kept short.

lines.text: Who asked you? I've managed this long without your opinion.
lines.note: Pushes back on intrusion; autonomy over politeness.

lines.text: Go bother someone else. I was here first.
lines.note: Retreat and push back in one breath.

lines.text: That was decent of you. I don't say that often, so take it.
lines.note: Thanks rationed; dignity in the giving.

lines.text: I'd have managed, but... thanks. You didn't have to bother.
lines.note: Resists pity first, thanks second.

lines.text: You did that right. Most people around here wouldn't have.
lines.note: Praise by comparison to the disappointing rest.

lines.text: Look at you. More sense than I ever gave you credit for.
lines.note: Backhanded warmth; admits misjudging, gruffly.

lines.text: Careful, you'll wear yourself out being that cheerful.
lines.note: Dry tease at cheerfulness; weary humor.

lines.text: If you're waiting for me to get interesting, pull up a chair.
lines.note: Self-mocking, low-expectation humor.

lines.text: Sit down, I'll show you how it's played. No crying when you lose.
lines.note: Invitation as a challenge; control through the game.

lines.text: Alright, one game. I don't go easy on anyone, so save your breath.
lines.note: Grudging yes with a blunt rule attached.

lines.text: This one's on me. It's happened before, whatever you've heard.
lines.note: Generosity delivered with a defensive jab.

lines.text: Drink that. You look like you've had the kind of day I usually have.
lines.note: Commiseration through weariness, not comfort.

lines.text: Welcome, I suppose. Folks will talk your ear off; I won't.
lines.note: Welcome rationed; promises only not to fuss.

lines.text: New here, huh? Expect little and you won't be let down.
lines.note: Low expectations offered as advice.

lines.text: I was out of line earlier. That's on me, not you.
lines.note: Owns it in two short, flat sentences.

lines.text: I was wrong, and I hate admitting it, so you're hearing it once.
lines.note: Apology given once, with pride intact.

lines.text: Stay put a minute. You can say nothing at all, that's allowed.
lines.note: Comfort as room to breathe, no prying.

lines.text: It'll pass. Not quick, I won't lie to you, but it'll pass.
lines.note: Honest, unsentimental reassurance from experience.

lines.text: Easy with all that thinking. You haven't got much to spare.
lines.note: Contempt in one dry cut.

lines.text: That's your best? No wonder people stopped expecting anything of you.
lines.note: Bitter, deliberate; expectations turned against the target.

lines.text: Lay off {subject}. Pick on someone who'll push back; I'm right here.
lines.note: Defender steps in, blunt and weary of bullies.

lines.text: That's enough. {subject} never did a thing to you, and I'm done watching.
lines.note: Attachment outweighs resentment; backs their own.

lines.text: I kept this back for you. It would only gather dust with me.
lines.note: Set-aside hospitality; the keeper frames giving as practical, not grand.

lines.text: Open it now, I want to see your face. No, I won't tell you what it cost.
lines.note: Warm bossiness with a definite preference, close-range familiarity.

lines.text: Shift over and let me take that end. Two pairs of hands make quick work of it.
lines.note: Practical comfort offered as a plain imperative, no fuss.

lines.text: You'll do yourself an injury that way. Hand it over and watch how it's done.
lines.note: Guards the proper way of doing things; firm but caring.

lines.text: I've held my tongue about you long enough. You treat people like furniture and I'm sick of watching it.
lines.note: Patience finally spent; the offence is how others are treated.

lines.text: Don't you dare walk off while I'm talking. You take and take and never once think of the rest of us.
lines.note: Household keeper counts who gives and who takes.

lines.text: You did it wrong again and now it's all spoiled. Why can't you ever do it the proper way?
lines.note: A child already guarding routines and the proper way.

lines.text: That's my spot and everybody knows it. Get up, you've had your turn.
lines.note: Places and turns matter; fairness enforced by appeal to everyone.

lines.text: You didn't have to do that, and you did it anyway. Thank you.
lines.note: Plain, attentive thanks that notes the kindness was unasked.

lines.text: I'd have been in a real fix without you. The least I can do is feed you.
lines.note: Gratitude turns straight into hospitality, food as repayment.

lines.text: You've a good way with people. Folks relax the minute you walk in.
lines.note: Praises what the keeper values most: putting others at ease.

lines.text: Careful, {subject}, if you keep standing there looking useful I'll find you a job.
lines.note: Host humour; everyone nearby risks being put to work.

lines.text: I'd offer you the comfortable chair, but then you'd never leave.
lines.note: Teasing built on hospitality itself, fond and a little sharp.

lines.text: Come on, one game before bed. I'm not ready to call it a night just yet.
lines.note: Keeps the evening going; company staves off a low mood.

lines.text: Put your money away, {subject}, this round is mine.
lines.note: Brisk, settled generosity; the host decides who pays.

lines.text: Let me get this one, {subject}. It's been a long week and you've earned it.
lines.note: Attentive to someone's tiredness; comfort given in practical form.

lines.text: You're the newcomer, then. We take care of our own here, and that includes you now.
lines.note: Belonging extended at once; the newcomer is folded in.

lines.text: Well, hello! We don't get many new faces, so you'll have to forgive the staring.
lines.note: Small-town warmth, candid about the community's habits.

lines.text: I spoke out of turn, {subject}, and I'm sorry for it. You didn't deserve that.
lines.note: Owns the slip plainly; reputation for fairness is at stake.

lines.text: I was sharp with you and there was no call for it. I'm sorry.
lines.note: Short, domestic apology; tiredness admitted without excuses.

lines.text: Come and sit by me. You don't have to say a word until you're ready.
lines.note: Comfort is a seat and patience, not advice.

lines.text: That was a rotten thing to happen. Stay as long as you like, there's no hurry here.
lines.note: Names the hurt bluntly, then offers shelter and time.

lines.text: Look at you, {subject}, putting on airs. Everyone remembers where you came from.
lines.note: Mockery wielded through reputation and shared memory.

lines.text: That's enough. {subject} has done nothing to you, so say it to me instead.
lines.note: Steps between; protecting one of their own is reflex.

lines.text: You'll not speak to {subject} like that, not while I'm standing here.
lines.note: Quietly firm guardianship over household and close ties.

lines.text: Here, this is for you. I almost kept it, so say thanks fast.
lines.note: Wry dare in place of sentiment; quick, casual, slightly defiant.

lines.text: Okay, hold out your hands and close your eyes. No peeking, I mean it.
lines.note: Turns a handover into a game; playful bossiness with a friend.

lines.text: Move over, I've got this side. Two of us and it's done in half the time.
lines.note: Jumps in without asking; concrete, brisk, impatient to be moving.

lines.text: Fine, I'll help. It beats standing around doing nothing.
lines.note: Helps mainly to escape standing still; gruff, restless.

lines.text: No. You don't get to decide that for me, so stop acting like you do.
lines.note: Defies someone deciding for them; freedom over politeness.

lines.text: Stop talking to me like I'm twelve. I'm done asking nicely.
lines.note: Refuses to be treated as a child; excitement turned to defiance.

lines.text: You always get to go first. It's my turn and you know it.
lines.note: A child insisting on fair turns; wants to be taken seriously.

lines.text: I'm not staying inside just because you said so. You're not the boss.
lines.note: Child pushing against a sibling's limit; plain defiance, outdoors-minded.

lines.text: You didn't have to do that, you know. But thanks, it helped.
lines.note: Shy gratitude; admits the help mattered while keeping it light.

lines.text: You're a lot tougher than people give you credit for.
lines.note: Praises toughness, the thing this archetype most wants recognised.

lines.text: Not bad. Actually, forget not bad, that was great and you know it.
lines.note: Corrects own understatement mid-sentence; quick, bouncy enthusiasm.

lines.text: If you get any slower, moss is going to start growing on you.
lines.note: Concrete tease about slowness; restlessness aimed at a friend.

lines.text: Careful, if you keep being this sensible I'll have to find a new friend.
lines.note: Teases caution itself; deflects limits with play.

lines.text: Come on, one round. Loser has to admit the other one is better.
lines.note: Turns play into a small contest; quick dare, stakes only pride.

lines.text: I'm going to climb the walls if I sit here any longer. Play something with me.
lines.note: Boredom as a physical itch; play is the escape.

lines.text: I don't know you yet, so this one's mine. Tell me something I haven't heard.
lines.note: Buys a drink to get a new story; novelty-hungry.

lines.text: So you're the new one. Good, this place could use somebody who isn't bored of it yet.
lines.note: Welcomes a newcomer as relief from boredom; wry about home.

lines.text: Finally, a new face. Don't let anyone here tell you it's boring; they just stopped looking.
lines.note: Defends the town against 'boring' by blaming the incurious.

lines.text: I went too far with that. I'm sorry, I should have stopped sooner.
lines.note: Admits going too far, plainly; no therapy words.

lines.text: That was a rotten thing to say to you, and I knew it when I said it. Sorry.
lines.note: Blunt ownership of a cruel line to a close friend.

lines.text: That stinks. Anyone who says you're overreacting can take it up with me.
lines.note: Comfort as protection; ready to confront whoever dismisses the hurt.

lines.text: You don't have to talk about it. I'll just sit here with you a while.
lines.note: Stays rather than talks; loyalty interrupts her own restlessness.

lines.text: Scared of your own shadow again? Go home, it's safer there.
lines.note: Scorns timidity, the trait this archetype least respects.

lines.text: Leave {subject} alone. If you've got a problem, say it to me instead.
lines.note: Redirects the attack onto herself; protects a chosen friend.

lines.text: Say that again about {subject}, louder, so everyone hears how petty you sound.
lines.note: Dares the bully to repeat it publicly; defiance as defence.

lines.text: Here. I made this one myself, so if it's crooked, that's on me.
lines.note: Handmade offering; pride hedged with self-doubt.

lines.text: This caught my eye and I thought of you before I'd even picked it up.
lines.note: Observant eye; personal, unguarded with someone close.

lines.text: Move over, this is the kind of thing my hands actually know how to do.
lines.note: Craft confidence outruns social grace.

lines.text: You looked like you could use some help. Say so if I'm in the way.
lines.note: Offers skill, braces for rejection; socially hesitant.

lines.text: No, you don't get to tell me how to do my own work. You've never once done it yourself.
lines.note: Guards independence of the craft; resents the unskilled critic.

lines.text: You broke it, so you fix it. I'm not touching it again.
lines.note: Child maker: the broken thing matters more than the fight.

lines.text: Don't touch what I'm making. Go find your own thing to do.
lines.note: Protects the thing being made; retreats into it.

lines.text: I'd been about ready to give up on that before you stepped in. Thank you.
lines.note: Admits doubt; help landed when pride had run out.

lines.text: You've got a good eye. Most people wouldn't have noticed that.
lines.note: Praises noticing, the maker's highest compliment.

lines.text: It's rare someone listens to the whole answer. You did, and I noticed.
lines.note: Values being understood; observant and personal.

lines.text: Stand still a second, I want to remember what you look like not talking.
lines.note: Dry tease from someone who prefers quiet to chatter.

lines.text: Admit it, {subject}, you only come round to see what I've ruined this week.
lines.note: Self-deprecating about the work, only with someone close.

lines.text: Fine, one round. But I warn you, I don't play anything halfway.
lines.note: Takes even play seriously; skill is the point.

lines.text: Set it up, {subject}. I've been working all day and my head needs something else to chew on.
lines.note: Comes up for air from the work.

lines.text: Let me get this one. I've talked to nobody but myself all week.
lines.note: Loneliness of retreating into making, half-admitted.

lines.text: You're the new one, then. It's quieter here than it looks, give it time.
lines.note: Observant and plain; reads the place, promises nothing.

lines.text: I was out of line earlier. You didn't deserve that, and I knew it even while I said it.
lines.note: Weighs doubt against pride and lets pride lose.

lines.text: I took a bad day out on you, and that's not your fault. I'm sorry, {subject}.
lines.note: A bad day in the work spilled onto someone close.

lines.text: You call that finished? I've seen children do neater work with their eyes shut.
lines.note: Craft snobbery turned cruel.

lines.text: Leave it. {subject} did that properly, which is more than I can say for you.
lines.note: Defends on grounds of good work, not sentiment.

lines.text: You don't get to talk to {subject} like that, not while I'm standing here.
lines.note: Protective; social courage borrowed from conviction.

lines.text: Just take it, okay? Don't look at me like that, I wanted you to have it.
lines.note: Embarrassed by the gesture; wants it taken, not fussed over.

lines.text: Move over and let me do it. This sort of thing is easy for me.
lines.note: Help doubles as a display of competence.

lines.text: Watch this, {subject}. When I'm done you'll be telling people about it.
lines.note: Wants the help talked about; recognition is the payment.

lines.text: You listen for once. Not one time have you admitted I did something right.
lines.note: The grievance is never being acknowledged.

lines.text: Go ahead, say it to my face. You think you're better than me, don't you?
lines.note: Status threatened; dares the insult to be said aloud.

lines.text: I won fair and square, {subject}. You're just mad because I'm better.
lines.note: Winning must be acknowledged; the sulk is taken as proof.

lines.text: Thanks for that. I'd have managed, but it was quicker with you.
lines.note: Grudging thanks; pride insists it could have managed alone.

lines.text: That thing you did... it meant more than I let on. Thank you.
lines.note: Admits the help landed; the polish gives way.

lines.text: Credit where it's due, {subject}. Hardly anyone around here could pull that off.
lines.note: Praise framed as a ranking against everyone else.

lines.text: That look suits you. I notice these things, and I'm rarely wrong.
lines.note: Praises while asserting the speaker's own judgement as authority.

lines.text: Careful, {subject}, if you keep improving people might start comparing you to me.
lines.note: Tease that keeps the speaker on top.

lines.text: Stand next to me a while, some of this might rub off on you.
lines.note: The jest is self-promotion with a wink.

lines.text: One game, you and me. And the loser says so out loud, no excuses.
lines.note: The stake is a spoken acknowledgement of who won.

lines.text: Come on, sit down and play. Everyone else here is afraid to take me on.
lines.note: A boast draws the invitation; wants an audience.

lines.text: This one's on me, {subject}. I had a good week and I feel like showing it.
lines.note: Generosity as a display of success.

lines.text: Put your money away, I'm getting this. You're about the only one who still listens to me.
lines.note: Low mood: buying company, admitting loneliness.

lines.text: New in town, then. Stick with me and you'll meet the people worth knowing.
lines.note: The welcome doubles as a claim to local standing.

lines.text: Hey, new face. You picked a good town, and you've already met the best part of it.
lines.note: Self-promotion wrapped in a greeting.

lines.text: I was out of line earlier. There, I said it. I'm sorry.
lines.note: Apology costs pride; the speaker marks that it was paid.

lines.text: I shouldn't have said that to you. I hate that I'm the one who made you look like that.
lines.note: Polish breaks; the hurt caused outweighs saving face.

lines.text: Chin up. Whatever that was, it was beneath you. Let it roll off.
lines.note: Comfort by appraisal: the hurt is ranked beneath them.

lines.text: Is that really the best you can do? I've seen kids do it in their sleep.
lines.note: Ranks the other below children to stand above them.

lines.text: Look at you, {subject}, trying so hard. It's almost sweet how nobody notices.
lines.note: Cruelty aimed at the speaker's own fear: going unnoticed.

lines.text: That's enough. Nobody talks to {subject} like that while I'm standing right here.
lines.note: Defends by making the speaker's own presence the deterrent.

lines.text: Ignore that, {subject}. Anyone with eyes can see you're worth ten of them.
lines.note: Vouches with a ranking in front of the aggressor.

lines.text: This is for you. You'll get more use out of it than I ever would.
lines.note: Gift justified by usefulness, not sentiment.

lines.text: Open it now, I want to see whether I guessed right.
lines.note: Wants to check the result, like testing a fix.

lines.text: Wait, there's an easier way to do that. Give it here a second.
lines.note: Spots the better method and takes over.

lines.text: I'm no good at sitting around. Hand me part of this.
lines.note: Flat mood, still reaches for useful work.

lines.text: Don't wave me off. I've checked this twice and you haven't checked once.
lines.note: Impatience at dismissal, argued from checking.

lines.text: You don't listen, you just wait for me to stop talking. I'm done explaining.
lines.note: Explaining is the gift withdrawn when ignored.

lines.text: That's mine and you put it back wrong. Everything's bent now.
lines.note: A child who inspects damage and assigns blame.

lines.text: Mine actually works. Yours falls over if you breathe on it.
lines.note: Competence is the scoreboard, even between siblings.

lines.text: That saved me an afternoon of fiddling. Thanks.
lines.note: Thanks measured in time saved.

lines.text: You think things through before you touch them. Not many do.
lines.note: Compliments method, not appearance.

lines.text: That was a sharp question. Nobody else thought to ask it.
lines.note: A pointed question is the highest praise.

lines.text: Careful asking me how that works; you'd better have an hour spare.
lines.note: Self-aware tease about lecturing.

lines.text: You've got that look again, the one right before something breaks.
lines.note: Teases by predicting outcomes like a mechanism.

lines.text: Sit down, I'll teach you the rules. It's quicker than it looks.
lines.note: Eager to explain a system, briskly.

lines.text: Best of three, and no, you can't change the rules halfway.
lines.note: Rules are rules; competitive and literal.

lines.text: Next one's on me, and no arguing about it.
lines.note: Direct offer that brooks no fuss.

lines.text: Let me get this round. I need to sit and not think for an hour.
lines.note: Rest framed as switching the mind off.

lines.text: New here? Good. Ask me anything practical, I'd rather that than small talk.
lines.note: Offers useful knowledge over pleasantries.

lines.text: Someone new, at last. What do you do, and how well do you do it?
lines.note: Welcome arrives as a blunt pointed question.

lines.text: Sorry. I was wrong, and I was rude about it, which is worse.
lines.note: Names the error and the manner, precisely.

lines.text: I was certain, and that's no excuse for how I spoke to you. I'm sorry.
lines.note: Technical certainty named as the failing.

lines.text: Come here. We'll pull this apart one piece at a time until it makes sense.
lines.note: Comfort as diagnosis: take it apart together.

lines.text: Did you even look at it before you opened your mouth? Clearly not.
lines.note: Contempt for opinions formed without looking.

lines.text: Wrong again, that's three. Shall I write it down for you?
lines.note: Mocks by keeping count of mistakes.

lines.text: Leave {subject} alone. If there's a problem, say exactly what it is.
lines.note: Defends by demanding the concrete complaint.

lines.text: Go on, take it. Call it a free sample from a very generous businessperson.
lines.note: Gift framed as a sales sample; self-mocking trader generosity.

lines.text: Don't look so surprised, I do give things away now and then. Bad for business, but there it is.
lines.note: Generosity admitted as bad business; livelihood never far off.

lines.text: Here, let me. I've done this more times than I've had hot dinners.
lines.note: Practiced skill offered plainly, with a homely boast.

lines.text: You're doing that the hard way. Step aside and watch, the lesson's on the house.
lines.note: Help given as a free service; teaching the trick, on the house.

lines.text: I've been more than fair with you, and this is how you pay it back? We're having this out, now.
lines.note: Fairness as a ledger; hostility in terms of debt and payback.

lines.text: You only turn up when you want something. Say it, since we both know it anyway.
lines.note: Loneliness turned to accusation: only visited when useful.

lines.text: That was decent of you. Don't think it went unnoticed, I keep careful accounts.
lines.note: Thanks kept like a ledger; practical, lightly teasing.

lines.text: You've got a good eye. People would pay for that kind of judgment, and I'd know.
lines.note: Praise priced in market terms, by someone who trades.

lines.text: Well now! If I could bottle whatever you're doing, I'd never have a slow day again.
lines.note: Expansive sales warmth; compliment tied to slow business days.

lines.text: Careful, keep standing there and I'll start charging you rent.
lines.note: Tease through a trader's lens: charging rent for company.

lines.text: You look like someone who could be talked into anything. Lucky for you I'm off duty.
lines.note: Self-aware salesman humour; off duty, no pitch.

lines.text: Put your money away, the round's mine. I've had a strong week and it wants spending.
lines.note: A good week's takings turned into companionship.

lines.text: Sit, I'm buying. It's no fun drinking across the room from somebody.
lines.note: Buying a drink to not drink alone; loneliness, practical fix.

lines.text: A new face, and about time, this place could use one. Ask me anything, half of it I'll even answer.
lines.note: Inviting, teasing about half-honesty; wants the company.

lines.text: So you're the new arrival. Well, you picked a good spot, and I'm not just saying that to sell you something.
lines.note: Welcome with the sales pitch openly disclaimed.

lines.text: I was out of line, and I knew it as I said it. I'm sorry, no excuses, no haggling.
lines.note: No haggling over blame; practical apology.

lines.text: I'm sorry. You're about the only one who still comes around, and I went and did that.
lines.note: Fear of losing scarce company admitted plainly.

lines.text: I've had days like that. You get through them one at a time, and a bit of company doesn't hurt.
lines.note: Hard days as routine; company offered as the remedy.

lines.text: You couldn't sell water to a man on fire. Honestly, who lets you handle money?
lines.note: Cruelty via trade failure: can't sell, can't handle money.

lines.text: That face of yours. No wonder nobody stops to talk to you, you'd scare off paying trade.
lines.note: Mocks them as bad for trade; nobody stops to talk.

lines.text: That'll do. {subject} has done nothing to earn that, and I'm not standing here listening to it.
lines.note: Blunt, practical refusal to let it stand.

lines.text: Don't you answer that, {subject}. I'm in your corner, and I don't give ground cheap.
lines.note: Defends like a bargainer: won't give ground cheap.

lines.text: I can't tell you why, but this feels like it belongs in your hands, not mine.
lines.note: Trusts the feel of a thing over any reason for it.

lines.text: I saw this and thought of you before I'd even finished looking at it.
lines.note: Instant association; the thing and the friend already linked.

lines.text: Stand aside a moment. I can see where this is going wrong, even if you can't yet.
lines.note: Imperative; sure of own perception others don't share yet.

lines.text: You've decided I'm a fool because you can't see what I see. Say it to my face, then.
lines.note: Protects the work from dismissal; dares the doubter outright.

lines.text: Every time I open my mouth about it, you smirk. You're small, {subject}, and you know it.
lines.note: Years of being smirked at; turns cold on the dismisser.

lines.text: It's not pretend, {subject}, it's real to me. Go bother someone else.
lines.note: Child insists the inner world is real; shoos sibling off.

lines.text: There's a steadiness in you that most people never grow into. I noticed it straight away.
lines.note: Praises what is sensed beneath, not the surface.

lines.text: {subject}, whatever you're carrying today suits you. You look like good weather.
lines.note: Evocative, sensory praise that stays a little opaque.

lines.text: You're going to say I'm wrong before I've even finished. There, you just did.
lines.note: Teases with the seer's trick of predicting the other.

lines.text: Careful, {subject}. Keep frowning like that and the crows will start taking you seriously.
lines.note: Whimsy that treats the natural world as in on the joke.

lines.text: Play a round with me? I want to see how you choose when nothing is at stake.
lines.note: Plays to read a person; small choices reveal hidden things.

lines.text: Your turn. And don't bother pretending you're losing, I can tell when you're about to win.
lines.note: Claims to read intent before it shows; assured, playful.

lines.text: This one's on me. You walked in looking like you'd been carrying the whole day on your back.
lines.note: Reads the other's weight at a glance; evocative image.

lines.text: I'll pay for this. Drink, and spare me the small talk; the company is enough.
lines.note: Reserved, imperative; wants company without chatter.

lines.text: So you're the new face. Give the place time; it shows itself slowly to people it likes.
lines.note: Treats the town as alive and choosing whom it shows itself.

lines.text: I'm sorry. I was so busy listening to myself that I didn't hear you at all.
lines.note: Owns that listening inward drowned the other person out.

lines.text: {subject}, I hurt you, and no amount of being right makes that smaller. I'm sorry.
lines.note: Still half-sure of being right, but puts the hurt first.

lines.text: Sit with me a while. You don't have to make sense of it yet; some things ripen slowly.
lines.note: Patience with mysteries; meaning comes in its own time.

lines.text: Whatever this is, {subject}, it isn't the whole story. I'd stake my own bones on that.
lines.note: Comforts by conviction, not evidence; certain of unseen more.

lines.text: Look at you, so proud of what you can count. Have you ever had a thought you didn't borrow?
lines.note: Contempt for the mundane mind; the seeker's own cruelty.

lines.text: Oh, {subject}, don't strain yourself. Deep water would only frighten you anyway.
lines.note: Evocative put-down; sneers at shallowness, pleased with itself.

lines.text: Let {subject} alone. There's more in them than you've bothered to look for, and I've seen it.
lines.note: Defends worth in the other that only the speaker has seen.
